LEGAL INFORMATION

Cookie Policy

Website information, your choices and our responsibilities.

Draft for company review. Prepared for the current website on 8 October 2026. Company approval and legal review are pending.

Privacy PolicyCookie PolicyTerms & ConditionsRecruitment Disclaimer

1. Cookies and browser storage

Cookies are small values saved by websites or service providers in your browser. Local storage is a separate browser-storage mechanism. This policy distinguishes the website's theme preference from cookies that a third-party service or hosting provider may use.

2. Storage used by this website

The current website code does not set first-party cookies and does not include analytics or advertising trackers. It uses local storage under the key ga-preview-theme to remember Warm Editorial, Classic Corporate or Fresh Blue & Teal. The stored value is the theme identifier, not your enquiry details. It is saved automatically when a theme is applied and has no expiry configured by the website. A theme URL parameter can override the saved choice. The session-storage key ga-intro-seen records that the opening logo animation has played so it does not repeat during navigation in the same tab. It contains no personal information and lasts for the browser tab session (which some browsers may restore).

3. Embedded Google Maps

Google Maps is embedded on the contact and office-location pages. Loading a map makes a request to Google and may involve Google cookies, existing Google-account settings or similar technologies. Names and lifetimes vary with Google's service, region and browser settings; this website does not maintain a fixed inventory of Google cookies. Read How Google uses cookies and Google's Privacy Policy.

4. Hosting and external links

A deployed host or sign-in layer may use storage for access control, sessions or security. These are separate from the static website code and depend on the deployment. Following an external link subjects your visit to that service's own storage practices.

5. Managing your choices

You can clear this site's cookies and site data in your browser settings to remove the saved theme. Browser controls can also restrict third-party cookies and storage; maps or other external features may then behave differently. Clearing the theme preference resets it, but a subsequent visit may save the default theme again. This version has no cookie-consent banner, granular consent manager or automatic blocking of embedded maps.

6. Changes and contact

If analytics, additional embeds or other storage are introduced, this inventory and any required choice controls should be updated before use. For questions, contact info@gadigital.in or 0120-4218525. Postal address: S-14, 2nd Floor, Aditya Mall, Indirapuram, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh – 201014. See also the Privacy Policy.
